page: Bearer Auth Middleware for token-based API authentication via Authorization header with Bearer scheme. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {bearerAuth} from 'hono/bearer-auth'. Token validation via Authorization header with 'Bearer {token}' format. curl example: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer honoiscool' http://localhost:8787/auth/page. Token regex pattern: /[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*/ supports URL-safe Base64 and standard Base64 encoded tokens including JWTs. Returns 400 if token doesn't match regex. Options: token (required, string | string[] for single or multiple valid tokens), realm (optional, string, default empty), prefix (optional, string, default 'Bearer'), headerName (optional, string, default 'Authorization'), hashFunction (optional, Function), verifyToken (optional, (token: string, c: Context) => boolean | Promise<boolean>), noAuthenticationHeader (optional, customize missing header response), invalidAuthenticationHeader (optional, customize invalid format response), invalidToken (optional, customize invalid token response). Error customization: wwwAuthenticateHeader (string | object | MessageFunction), message (string | object | MessageFunction). HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE. Use cases: API token auth, role-based tokens, custom verification. MessageFunction: (c: Context) => string | object | Promise<string | object>. Questions: How to add bearer auth to routes? Can I use multiple tokens? How to verify tokens custom way? What's the token format? How to customize error responses? Can I change the header name?

sections.manifest: Import statements for Bearer Auth middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for the main framework class. import {bearerAuth} from 'hono/bearer-auth' for the middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is bearerAuth located?

Bearer Auth usage patterns and examples. Pattern 1: Single token with path restriction. app.use('/api/*', bearerAuth({token})) where token is 'honoiscool'. Responds with c.json() on success. Pattern 2: Route-specific with HTTP method. app.post('/api/page', bearerAuth({token}), handler) protects POST only. Pattern 3: Multiple tokens array. bearerAuth({token: [readToken, privilegedToken]}) accepts any valid token. Pattern 4: Role-based with different tokens per method. GET requests use readToken or privilegedToken, POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE use privilegedToken only. app.on(method, path, handler) for method-based routing. Pattern 5: Custom verification with verifyToken. verifyToken (token, c) => boolean | Promise<boolean> returns true for valid tokens. Example token: 'dynamic-token'. Token regex note: /[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*/ must match or 400 error returned. Supports Base64 and JWT formats. Questions: How to require bearer token? How to support multiple tokens? How to verify tokens with custom logic? What token formats work? How to restrict by HTTP method?

Bearer Auth options specification. Required: token (string | string[], the token(s) to validate against). Optional: realm (string, default empty, used in WWW-Authenticate header per MDN), prefix (string, default 'Bearer', the schema in Authorization header), headerName (string, default 'Authorization', which header to check), hashFunction (Function for token hashing), verifyToken ((token: string, c: Context) => boolean | Promise<boolean> for custom verification). Error customization objects: noAuthenticationHeader (for missing header: wwwAuthenticateHeader string | object | MessageFunction, message string | object | MessageFunction), invalidAuthenticationHeader (for invalid format: same fields), invalidToken (for invalid token: same fields). MessageFunction signature: (c: Context) => string | object | Promise<string | object>. Questions: Which options are required? What's the default prefix and header? Can I customize error responses? What error types exist? How to handle missing vs invalid vs wrong tokens?
